title: The jailer's file: submariners on LSD
place_text: a US military base (file found by McKinnon)

tellings.quote: on one site I found the jailer's file. Every military base has a jailer. M. And it's just crazy. You've got guys taking LSD that work on submarines.

plain: While breaking into US military computers around 2000 to 2002, Gary McKinnon, a hacker who says he searched those systems for signs of a secret space program, found the 'jailer's file' of a military base, a record of discipline cases, which showed submarine crew taking LSD. McKinnon tells this himself, noting that 'every military base has a jailer' and calling what he read 'just crazy.' If true, it shows what kind of private records he says he could reach.
